Name: Jehoiakim, King of Judah
Summary: Jehoiakim, born Eliakim, was set on the throne by Pharaoh Necho, taxed Judah to pay Egypt, served Nebuchadnezzar three years and then rebelled, and died as Babylon closed in.
KeyStory: Jehoiakim taxes Judah, serves Babylon, then rebels.
KeyVerses: 2 Kings 23:36; 2 Kings 24:1; 2 Kings 24:6; 2 Chronicles 36:4; 2 Chronicles 36:5; 2 Chronicles 36:6; Jeremiah 22:18-19; Jeremiah 26:21-23; Jeremiah 36:23; Jeremiah 36:28-31
RelatedPeople: King Josiah; Zebudah, Mother of Jehoiakim; King Nebuchadnezzar; Jehoiachin, King of Judah; Jehoahaz, Son of Josiah; Jeconiah; Jeremiah; Urijah, Son of Shemaiah; Jehudi
LifeLesson: A king who taxes God's people to pay foreign masters has already surrendered.
RelatedEvents: Fall of Jerusalem and the Exile
